title: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
benefit: ₹6,000 per year direct bank transfer in 3 installments
eligibility: Small and marginal landholder farmer families

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
benefit: Comprehensive crop insurance against non-preventable natural risks
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers growing notified crops

title: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
benefit: Pan-India electronic trading portal for farm produce
eligibility: All farmers and FPOs with valid APMC registration
